2. Pushes images to Artifact Registry

4. Argo CD reconciles dev cluster

Legend
■ gray — clients (browser / mobile)
■ blue — edge / GCP boundary
■ red — backend services (Spring Boot)
■ green — managed data
■ yellow — auth + AI
■ purple — CI/CD + secrets
solid line — synchronous request
dashed line — async / verification

div.div:
CI/CD flow
1. Cloud Build builds JVM (Jib) + web (Docker) on PR + main
2. Pushes images to Artifact Registry
3. Bumps image tags in infra/k8s/* via post-build commit
4. Argo CD reconciles dev cluster
Secret flow
Secret Manager → External Secrets Operator → k8s Secret
